headline: O’Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Raises Guidance—Can Margins Keep Up With Growth?
summary: O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. (NASDAQ:ORLY) recently reported solid financial results for the second quarter of 2026. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, sales increased by $367 million, or 8%, to $4.89 billion from $4.53 billion in the same period last year. headline: Microsoft joins, Broadcom exits Goldman’s top-stocks list
summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs reshuffled its U.S. Conviction List in its August update, adding Microsoft and five other names while removing Broadcom and three others.
